flag.allPass: Everything for dis sheet add up well.
flag.VOTES_CAST_GT_ACCREDITED: Di sheet show say votes wey dem cast ({actual}) pass di voters wey dem accredit ({expected}).
flag.ACCREDITED_GT_REGISTERED: Di sheet show say accredited voters ({actual}) pass di people wey register ({expected}).
flag.PARTY_SUM_NE_TOTAL_VALID: Di party scores add up to {actual}, but di sheet talk say total valid votes na {expected}.
flag.VALID_PLUS_REJECTED_NE_CAST: Valid votes plus rejected ballots na {actual}, but di sheet talk say {expected} votes na im dem cast.
flag.MISSING_FIELD: We no fit read {label}. Snap am again small closer, or another witness photo fit fill am.
flag.WORDS_DIGITS_CONFLICT: {label} for words no be di same as for figures. We use di figures.
flag.LOW_CONFIDENCE: Some part of dis photo hard to read (di reader sure {pct}%). Photo wey clear well go help.
flag.NOT_A_RESULT_SHEET: Dis one no resemble polling unit result sheet. Snap di sheet wey get di vote figures.
flag.SHEET_ILLEGIBLE: Di photo too blur, too dark or e cut. Abeg snap am again for better light.
home.hero.title: Every result sheet,
home.hero.body: Snap di EC8A wey dem paste for your polling unit. We go seal am, read am, and check am against wetin dem announce.
home.stat.mismatch: {n} unit(s) wey wetin dem announce no match di wall
home.step1.title: Snap & seal
home.step1.body: Your phone dey put fingerprint (SHA-256) for di photo di moment you snap am, so if anybody change am later, e go show.
home.step2.title: AI read, rules check
home.step2.body: We read di numbers from di sheet, then check dem with simple arithmetic rules.
home.step3.title: Witnesses confirm
home.step3.body: One clear EC8A photo fit confirm di result after 5 hours; we go compare am with wetin dem announce.
units.subtitle: All di polling units wey CounTrack dey track, with witness status and wetin no match. Open one to see di photos and comparisons.
units.search: Search code, name, ward or LGA
units.empty.title: No polling unit yet
capture.subtitle: Stand close, make di whole sheet enter di photo, and avoid light wey dey shine for am.
queue.subtitle: Di photos go stay for dis phone till dem upload, even if network no dey.
queue.empty.body: Photos wey you snap go show here till dem upload and we read dem.
home.sticker: Seal am · Read am · Check am ·
home.seal.title: E seal di second you snap
home.seal.body: Your phone dey stamp every photo with SHA-256 fingerprint before e comot your hand. Change even one pixel, di fingerprint go break. Di evidence go talk for itself.
home.two.title: Two witness. One truth.
home.two.body: No single photo dey decide anything. When two witness wey no know each other get sheets wey read di same, di unit go confirm.
home.two.live: {v} out of {n} polling units don confirm now now
home.demo.title: Wetin dem announce match di wall?
home.demo.body: Search any polling unit to see di confirmed wall result side by side with wetin dem announce. You no get unit for mind? Drag di example below.
home.roles.title: Wetin be your part?
home.role.witness.title: I dey for polling unit
home.role.witness.body: Snap di EC8A wey dey wall. E dey work without network, e go upload when network come back.
home.role.agent.title: I be party agent
home.role.agent.body: Put di figures wey dem announce for collation, see sharp sharp if e match di wall.
home.role.observer.title: I dey watch di count
home.role.observer.body: Check every polling unit, di photos, wetin we read and anything wey no match.

sol.safety.title: Safety check-ins
sol.safety.notEnough: Check-ins never reach to show total.
sol.safety.notEnough.why: Total go show once enough people don check in, so nobody go fit single anybody out.
